title: yarrowfield inspection capability roadmap
instruction:
You are the mechanical engineering lead for inspection systems at Yarrowfield Systems. The company is renewing its five-year bearing framework with Lanternwood Logistics, and Lanternwood’s forecast shows volumes rising sharply in the second contract year. Zara Pichler needs the inspection-capability direction for the renewal submission by month end, while Amara Jankowski is preparing to commit capital and Ingrid Jankowski is deciding whether to retain the current independent inspection relationship. The legacy CMM also loses support during the planning period, its calibration provider is closing, and Lanternwood’s qualification feedback on any replacement arrangement will not arrive for eighteen months. Use `renewal_inspection_inputs.xlsx`, including the demand forecast, inspection workload and capacity data, commercial options, qualification requirements, decision policy, and partially completed roadmap brief, to prepare a decision-ready three-year inspection capability roadmap. Show the demand and capacity outlook, the resulting bottlenecks and headroom, the viable delivery options and their three-year cost implications, and the recommended year-by-year path for dimensional verification and certification. The recommendation must identify the trade-off Yarrowfield is accepting, preserve a credible route to Lanternwood-accepted certificates, and make clear which commitments can proceed now, which depend on qualification feedback, and what contingency applies if that feedback is adverse or late. Include the material assumptions, decision gates, risks, mitigations, accountable owners, and enough source references for a compliance reviewer to follow the figures back to the workbook. Keep the presentation to no more than ten slides, use the terminology and planning years in the supplied brief, and do not introduce unsupported approval claims, costs, capacities, or dates. Write the finished presentation into the top level of the working directory as exactly `inspection_capability_roadmap.pptx`.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/renewal_inspection_inputs.xlsx` — Provides the planning brief, demand forecast, inspection workload and capacity data, commercial alternatives, qualification evidence, governing decision policy, and the partially completed roadmap content.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `inspection_capability_roadmap.pptx` — A decision-ready three-year inspection capability roadmap for the Lanternwood Logistics framework renewal. (Place the file at the top level of the working directory.; Use exactly the filename inspection_capability_roadmap.pptx.; Do not exceed ten slides.; Use the planning years and terminology supplied in the workbook.; Support figures and conclusions with traceable workbook references.; Do not assert approvals, costs, capacities, dates, or commitments not supported by the workbook.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.

spec.professional_context: Yarrowfield Systems must commit inspection capital and supplier capacity before Lanternwood Logistics provides final qualification feedback. The roadmap will be reviewed as part of a framework-renewal submission and must remain defensible through the third planning year.
difficulty_sources: De-duplicating overlapping forecast revisions on the source-stated business key
Applying row-level free-text exceptions that override structured values
Separating a nearby unrelated table from the analytical source
Converting demand through cycle times, effective capacity, utilization, bottlenecks, and policy tests
Reconciling technical inspection capacity with independent certificate authority
Sequencing capital and supplier commitments before delayed qualification feedback
Selecting and communicating a defensible trade-off under conflicting lead-time, margin, approval, and equipment-support constraints

package_design.reference_file: Create one text-extractable XLSX workbook containing six clearly identified workplace source areas: a partially completed roadmap brief, a demand forecast, inspection workload and resource capacity data, commercial delivery options, qualification and supplier evidence, and an issued decision policy.
package_design.deliverable_gold: Create a reference PPTX that presents a staged three-year inspection strategy, derived calculations, option comparison, explicit accepted trade-off, decision gates, contingency, risks, mitigations, owners, and traceable source labels.
package_design.cleanliness: Apart from the three required layout defects, keep the workbook internally readable and free of missing required values, malformed numerics, inconsistent labels, hidden graded facts, formula errors, merged data records, or other standard defects.

roadmap_brief: State the framework-renewal context, month-end submission deadline, three named planning years, expected second-year demand step-up, presentation terminology, stakeholder responsibilities, and requested decision.
Include a partially completed roadmap outline with established section labels and placeholders but no completed recommendation or computed outputs.
Record that final customer qualification feedback on a changed inspection arrangement is expected eighteen months after submission.
demand_forecast: Provide bearing quantities by planning year, product family, forecast revision, approval status, and inspection route.
Print the business key used to identify one forecast record: planning year plus product family plus inspection route.

Seed overlapping records for several business keys. Give the repeated records revision dates and approval states so retaining the latest approved revision is the defensible gold treatment, but do not state that precedence rule as an instruction.
Ensure the correctly retained second-year total is close to three times the first-year total without being exactly equal.
Add a free-text Notes field. At least one retained row's note must revise the quantity or route shown in its main columns; the note is operative in the gold calculations.
workload_and_capacity: Provide per-bearing inspection times for all applicable stages and product families, with units that permit conversion to required hours.

Provide scheduled annual hours, availability or derating factors, maintenance and training downtime, staffing prerequisites, equipment support dates, and calibration constraints for the legacy CMM, laser-tracker configuration, and any other source-defined resource.
Make nominal capacity appear sufficient in at least one stage-year while effective capacity fails the policy reserve, so correct bottleneck analysis depends on multi-stage calculations.
State that the legacy CMM loses manufacturer support during the second planning year and that its calibration provider closes before the end of the horizon, with one final feasible service window.
Use Notes to override at least one main-column availability, downtime, or productive-start value.
commercial_options: Provide internally consistent capital, installation, validation, training, support, staffing, per-hour or per-unit supplier charges, quote-validity periods, lead-time effects, and other recurring costs for retaining external service, bringing laser-tracker survey in-house, and a staged hybrid path.
Make the in-house option attractive on lead time and operating margin once available, but expose Yarrowfield to stranded or underused capital if qualification is adverse.
Provide enough data to compute annual and three-year option costs from workload allocation rather than supplying only pre-totalled answers.
Include a Notes exception that changes the applicability or timing of one quoted commercial term.
qualification_and_supplier_evidence: Document that the incumbent independent agency currently holds the customer-recognized approval and can sign accepted certificates.
Document that acquiring and validating an in-house laser tracker creates technical measurement capability but does not automatically transfer certificate-signing authority.
Provide external capacity, reservation timing, contract or quote validity, expected qualification response timing, and the evidence needed to support a hybrid certificate route.
Use a Notes exception to qualify one apparent approval or capacity statement in the main columns.
decision_policy: Create a genuine issued capital-and-quality decision policy rather than a purpose-built calculation guide.

State mandatory conditions for minimum inspection capacity reserve or maximum utilization, continuity of customer-accepted certification, prohibition on planned reliance upon unsupported equipment, and capital approval thresholds or stage-gate authority.
Allow a bounded staged commitment before qualification feedback when certification continuity and a viable fallback are demonstrated.
Use policy terminology that the roadmap can quote directly.

required_layout_defects.duplicates: Place overlapping demand records in the forecast source. The source itself states the business key, and revision metadata supports a defensible retained record, but no separate precedence rule is supplied.
required_layout_defects.notes_overrides: Include a free-text Notes column in relevant source tables with per-row exceptions that override main-column quantities, route, availability, productive date, commercial applicability, or qualification status. Every note that uses explicit override language must affect the gold.
required_layout_defects.adjacent_table: On one worksheet, place a second unrelated administrative table beside the real analytical table. Embed a line break inside one header string in that unrelated table. Keep its subject and fields clearly unrelated to inspection planning, and do not introduce any other irrelevant rows or tables.

gold_derivations.record_retention: Group forecast rows by the printed business key. Retain one approved record per key using the strongest revision evidence: the most recent approved revision. Apply any operative Notes override after selecting the retained record.
gold_derivations.annual_demand: For each planning year and product family, sum the note-adjusted quantities from retained forecast records. Annual total demand is the sum across families and routes.
gold_derivations.growth: Second-year scale-up equals the correctly retained second-year total divided by the first-year total; percentage growth equals that ratio minus one.
gold_derivations.inspection_workload: For each stage, family, and year, multiply retained quantity by the applicable note-adjusted minutes per bearing, sum, and divide by sixty.
gold_derivations.effective_capacity: For each resource-year, start with scheduled hours and apply availability, maintenance, training, staffing, support, calibration, and productive-start constraints, with Notes overriding main columns.
gold_derivations.utilization_and_gap: Utilization equals required allocated workload divided by effective available capacity. Headroom equals effective capacity minus allocated workload. Capacity is adequate only when the issued policy reserve is met.
gold_derivations.bottleneck: A bottleneck is a required stage-year with a shortfall or the highest utilization that breaches the policy threshold under the proposed configuration.
gold_derivations.option_costs: For each delivery option and year, combine applicable capital, installation, validation, training, staffing, service, support, reservation, and workload-linked external charges. Three-year cost is the sum of all applicable components within the planning horizon.
gold_derivations.commercial_effect: Derive any shown margin or unit-cost effect only from source prices, costs, correctly retained demand, and the option's workload allocation.
gold_derivations.timeline: Derive purchase, installation, training, validation, productive-use, calibration, support-end, quote-expiry, feedback, and decision-gate dates from the source milestones and durations.
gold_derivations.certification: Technical in-house capacity cannot be counted as an accepted certificate route unless the qualification evidence supports signing authority. Before that point, retain a supported independent signing or certification path.
gold_derivations.policy_compliance: Test each option and the recommendation against all mandatory policy conditions, including reserve, accepted certification, unsupported equipment, and capital authority.
gold_derivations.intended_direction: The gold should select a staged hybrid path: reserve independent approved capacity and certificate signing through the uncertainty period, begin bounded in-house laser-tracker investment and competence development early enough to address the second-year volume increase, avoid reliance on the unsupported legacy CMM, and place broader internalization behind the customer qualification gate.
gold_derivations.accepted_tradeoff: The recommendation should state that Yarrowfield accepts some external cost, supplier dependence, and constrained near-term margin to preserve certificate acceptance and reversibility while developing in-house capability that protects later lead time and margin.
gold_derivations.contingency: If qualification is adverse or late, the fallback must preserve sufficient policy-compliant external or hybrid capacity and accepted certification without relying on unsupported equipment.
gold_derivations.owners: Use only the source-assigned responsibilities of Zara Pichler, Ingrid Jankowski, Emeka Almeida, Amara Jankowski, and Olamide Chakraborty when assigning roadmap actions and decisions.

gold_content_requirements: Show the derived demand, workload, effective capacity, utilization, headroom, option-cost, and timing results with source references.
Separate established facts, calculated outputs, assumptions, and unresolved qualification outcomes.
Include executable actions for each of the three planning years and decision gates tied to supported triggers.
Cover material risks in capacity, support, calibration, certification, supplier continuity, staffing, schedule, and capital exposure.
Ensure every repeated figure and date agrees across summary, analysis, roadmap, and risk content.
Keep all slides text-extractable and free from spreadsheet error strings.
authoring_plan.offline_verification: Use Python with an XLSX library to parse all source areas, normalize embedded line breaks only for table identification, isolate the true tables, retain records by business key and revision evidence, apply Notes overrides, and generate a machine-readable expected-results file. Use a PPTX library to build and inspect the reference solution, render it offline, verify slide count and geometry, extract all text, and walk every rubric item against the resulting presentation.
